definitions.ES5: mean of ceil(5%*T) worst adjusted-adjusted_net trades
definitions.max_loss_streak: sort outcome_available,exit,symbol,identity,signal; strictly negative increments; zero resets
definitions.realized_drawdown: sum adjusted adjusted_net per outcome_available timestamp; chronological cumulative peak drawdown; simultaneous outcomes netted

limitations: Realized equal-notional trade bps are not account return or MTM DD.
Legacy parent ledgers without partial-cashflow fields permit adjusted_net/cost/summary verification but not independent decomposition of every partial fill.
Non-occupancy rejection reasons are conserved by saved counters, not re-executed on candles.
Historical data remains development diagnosis, not genuine fresh.
method: Independent Python standard-library arithmetic directly on saved JSON/gzip; no project metric/runner/execution import; no signals generated; no economic replay.

occupancy_saved_ledger_check.non_occupancy_rejection_limitation: Counts conserved; price/cost gate decisions are not rerun from historical candles.
